uiConfig.name: Everflow Postback
uiConfig.description: Connect Everflow using an Advertiser S2S Postback URL

fields.label: Postback URL
fields.note: Find this in Everflow at Control Center → Platform Configurations → General → Global Postback. Paste only the base URL and remove everything from ? onward.

fields.label: Network ID
fields.note: Find this in the Global Postback card. Everflow prefills the NID when you access the Postback URL.

fields.label: Verification Token
fields.note: Find this in Everflow at Advertisers → [Advertiser] → Edit → Advanced Options → Additional Information.
